group.passage: Oscar is a therapy cat which has been living in a nursing home in the U.S. state of Rhode Island since 2005. Patients who are seriously ill go there when they need special care because their lives are about to end. The nursing home is pet-friendly. Pets are allowed to visit and live there, which is why Oscar was adopted along with five other cats in 2005; they are supposed to help calm the patients and make them happy. Unlike other lovable cats, Oscar is a bit aloof and prefers to be left alone. After Oscar had spent about six months at the nursing home, some staff members noticed that he could predict impending death by napping on those patients just a few hours before they passed away. Therefore, the nursing home staff began to monitor Oscar closely. After Oscar accurately predicted 25 cases, they started calling patients’ family as soon as they found Oscar napping next to someone to give them the last chance to say goodbye to their beloved family member. Oscar’s story made headlines in 2007, and it is believed that he had already accurately predicted 100 cases by 2015. There are several hypotheses to explain Oscar’s ability to predict death. One is that Oscar can smell the biochemicals released by dying cells. Another explanation is that instead of a smell, Oscar senses the lack of movement in the room. In Oscar’s case, staff noticed Oscar napping by a patient who subsequently died, and they tend to accept or notice information if it appears to confirm what they already believe or expect. No matter which hypothesis is the most plausible, it will not change the fact that Oscar is truly an amazing cat.

questions.stem: Which of the following is the best title for this passage?

options.A: The Last Journey of Life of a Dying Patient
options.C: The Patients and Their Families in a Nursing Home
options.D: Pets as Doctors in a Nursing Home

questions.stem: According to the passage, which statement is true about Oscar, the therapy cat?

options.A: Oscar usually hisses at those who are sick in bed.
options.B: Oscar brings a lot of joy and happiness to the staff of the nursing home.
options.C: Oscar often sleeps next to a patient before they pass away.
options.D: Oscar makes the round as a doctor every day.

questions.stem: What does the word “impending” in paragraph 2 most likely mean?
According to the article, which of the following is INCORRECT?

options.A: Oscar is a little unfriendly by nature.
options.B: Oscar is not the only cat adopted by the nursing home.
options.C: The staff members of the nursing home knew right from the start that Oscar had the ability to predict death.
options.D: Thanks to Oscar, the dying patients are able to see their beloved family members one last time.
